# KMPMedia

> A Kotlin Multiplatform (Android + iOS) Jetpack-Compose media library for **animated, interactive, runtime-editable vector SVG**, plus image, audio and video. Everything renders into native Compose `Canvas`, so SVGs stay live vectors you can animate, clip, layer and edit at runtime — not bitmaps. The public API is small, declarative, and consistently prefixed `OG*`, which makes it well-suited for LLM code generation: describe *what* you want (a shape, an animation set, a cue at a timestamp, a depth) and pass it as data.

This file is a condensed, machine-readable API reference for coding agents. Every signature and recipe below is copied from the real source (`library/src/commonMain`) and compiles as written. When in doubt, prefer these primitives over hand-rolled Compose Canvas code.

## Rules for generating correct KMPMedia code

- All imports come from `com.solidkey.painpoints.*` (sub-packages listed per primitive below).
- You point a primitive at content with a **source type**, never a raw `String`:
  `OGImageUrlType("https://…")`, `OGVideoUrlType("https://…")`, `OGSvgUrlType("https://…")` (each also has `…FileType` / `…ResourceFileType` variants). All are subtypes of `OGSourceType`.
- **Two different scale types** — do not mix them:
  - `OGImageView(contentScale = …)` takes Compose's `androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale` (`ContentScale.Fit` / `ContentScale.Crop`).
  - `OGPlayerConfig(contentScale = …)` (video) takes `OGVideoScale` (`OGVideoScale.FIT` / `OGVideoScale.FILL`).
- Shape enum values are `OGShapeType.CIRCLE | TRIANGLE_UP | TRIANGLE_DOWN | SQUARE | RECTANGLE | DIAMOND` (there is no bare `TRIANGLE`).
- Animation set values are `OGAnimationType.SCALE | ROTATE | FADE | TRANSLATE` (pass a `Set`).
- `OGImageView` has a **required** `onEventTriggered: (OGLayerItemEvent, String) -> Unit` param — pass `onEventTriggered = { _, _ -> }` if you don't need it.
- `OGAVPlayer` has a **required** `action: OGAVPlayerAction` and `onError: (DAVPlayerError) -> Unit`.

## Core primitives (exact signatures)

### Image — `com.solidkey.painpoints.image`
```kotlin
@Composable
fun OGImageView(
    source: OGSourceType,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    displayShape: OGShapeType = OGShapeType.RECTANGLE,
    cornerRadius: Dp = 0.dp,
    contentScale: ContentScale = ContentScale.Fit,   // Compose ContentScale
    alignment: Alignment = Alignment.Center,
    clipShape: Shape? = null,   // optional free-form clip (e.g. OGPolygonShape); overrides displayShape when set
    softEdge: Dp = 0.dp,        // > 0 → feather the clip edge (vignette) instead of a hard cut
    maskBrush: Brush? = null,   // gradient alpha mask (edge fade / spotlight); to Color.Transparent
    draggable: Boolean = false,
    zIndex: Float = 0f,
    onError: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
    onEventTriggered: (OGLayerItemEvent, String) -> Unit,   // REQUIRED
)
```

### Animate any static image/SVG — `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.animating`
```kotlin
@Composable
fun OGAnimatedImage(
    source: OGSourceType,
    animations: Set<OGAnimationType>,   // SCALE|ROTATE|FADE|TRANSLATE
    width: Float = 512f,
    height: Float = 512f,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    durationMillis: Int = 1200,
    intensity: Float = 1f,
    slidePx: Float = 40f,
    onError: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
)

// Wrap arbitrary content instead of a source:
@Composable
fun OGAnimatedContainer(
    animations: Set<OGAnimationType>,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    durationMillis: Int = 1200,
    slidePx: Float = 40f,
    intensity: Float = 1f,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
)
```

### SVG — `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.svg` and `…svg.animation`
```kotlin
@Composable
fun OGSVGView(source: OGSourceType, width: Float, height: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
              enableDrag: Boolean = false, scalingBehavior: SVGScalingBehavior = SVGScalingBehavior.CLIP,
              onError: ((String) -> Unit)? = null)

// Plays the SMIL <animate>/<animateTransform> subset embedded in the SVG:
@Composable
fun OGSVGAnimationPlayer(source: OGSourceType, width: Float, height: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
                         isPlaying: Boolean = true, loop: Boolean = true,
                         scalingBehavior: SVGScalingBehavior = SVGScalingBehavior.CLIP,
                         onError: ((String) -> Unit)? = null)
```

### Video — `com.solidkey.painpoints.video.playing`
```kotlin
@Composable
expect fun OGAVPlayer(
    action: OGAVPlayerAction,                 // PLAY|PAUSE|STOP|REWIND
    source: OGSourceType,
    config: OGPlayerConfig = OGPlayerConfig(),
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    controller: OGAVPlayerController? = null, // rememberOGAVPlayerController()
    onError: (DAVPlayerError) -> Unit,        // REQUIRED
    onProgress: ((OGPlaybackStatus) -> Unit)? = null,
    cues: List<OGCue> = emptyList(),
): OGAVPlayerResult

data class OGPlayerConfig(
    val showDefaultControls: Boolean = false,
    val displayShape: OGShapeType = OGShapeType.RECTANGLE,
    val cornerRadius: Dp = 8.dp,
    val backgroundColor: Color = Color.Black,
    val contentScale: OGVideoScale = OGVideoScale.FIT,   // OGVideoScale, not Compose ContentScale
    val playbackConfig: OGVideoPlaybackConfig = OGVideoPlaybackConfig(),
)
data class OGVideoPlaybackConfig(val autoStart: Boolean = true, val autoRepeat: Boolean = false,
                                 val startDelay: Long = 0L, val loopCount: Int = 0)
```

### Interactive video: cues + live position — `com.solidkey.painpoints.video.playing`
```kotlin
OGCue.at(atMs: Long, onFire: () -> Unit): OGCue                    // point cue
OGCue.range(fromMs: Long, toMs: Long, onEnter: () -> Unit = {}, onExit: () -> Unit = {}): OGCue

@Composable fun rememberOGAVPlayerController(): OGAVPlayerController
class OGAVPlayerController {
    val status: State<OGPlaybackStatus>   // live: positionMs, durationMs, progress (0f..1f), isPlaying
    fun play(); fun pause(); fun stop(); fun seekTo(positionMs: Long); fun seekBy(deltaMs: Long)
}
```

### Depth / layering — `com.solidkey.painpoints.depth`
```kotlin
fun Modifier.ogDepth(depth: Float, focalDepth: Float, config: OGDepthConfig = OGDepthConfig()): Modifier
// depth & focalDepth are 0f..1f. Distance from the focal plane drives z-order + blur + dim (+ optional parallax).

@Composable fun OGDepthField(focalDepth: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit)
@Composable fun OGDepthObject(depth: Float, modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
                              focalDepth: Float = LocalOGFocalDepth.current,
                              config: OGDepthConfig = OGDepthConfig(), content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit)
data class OGDepthConfig(val maxBlur: Dp = 12.dp, val minAlpha: Float = 0.4f, val dimFalloff: Float = 0.5f,
                         val blurContent: Boolean = true, val depthScale: OGDepthScale? = null)
```

### Shape clipping — `com.solidkey.painpoints.shape`
```kotlin
enum class OGShapeType { CIRCLE, TRIANGLE_UP, TRIANGLE_DOWN, SQUARE, RECTANGLE, DIAMOND }
fun OGShapeType.toShape(cornerRadius: Dp = 0.dp): Shape   // -> a Compose Shape for Modifier.clip(...)

// Free-form polygon lasso (AI-friendly): clip to any outline of line segments. Points are normalized
// 0..1 (top-left origin), joined in order and auto-closed; <3 points = empty. It's a Compose Shape, so
// pass it to OGImageView(clipShape = ...) or any Modifier.clip(...). See docs/POLYGON_SHAPE.md.
data class OGPoint(val x: Float, val y: Float)
class OGPolygonShape(val points: List<OGPoint>) : Shape {
    companion object { fun of(vararg points: Pair<Float, Float>): OGPolygonShape }
}

// Morph the clip mask itself (video/GIF/photo) from one shape to another as progress 0f..1f runs.
// Sample-once/lerp-per-frame → 60fps. Drop into any clipShape slot. See docs/SHAPE_MORPH_CLIPS.md.
class OGMorphShape(val from: Shape, val to: Shape, val progress: Float, val sampleCount: Int = 96) : Shape
fun ogMorphSequence(stops: List<Shape>, progress: Float, sampleCount: Int = 96): Shape

// Multi-region clip: combine several placed sub-shapes with a path op (union/intersect/difference/xor).
// Each region sits in a normalized 0..1 sub-rect. A plain Shape → any clipShape slot (image/GIF/video).
enum class OGClipOp { UNION, INTERSECT, DIFFERENCE, XOR }
data class OGClipRegion(val shape: Shape, val left: Float = 0f, val top: Float = 0f, val right: Float = 1f, val bottom: Float = 1f)
class OGMultiRegionShape(val regions: List<OGClipRegion>, val op: OGClipOp = OGClipOp.UNION) : Shape {
    companion object {
        fun union(vararg shapes: Shape): OGMultiRegionShape
        fun of(vararg regions: OGClipRegion, op: OGClipOp = OGClipOp.UNION): OGMultiRegionShape
    }
}
```

### Soft & gradient masks — `com.solidkey.painpoints.mask`
```kotlin
// Feather (soften) a shape clip's edge, or fade content by an arbitrary gradient brush. One offscreen
// BlendMode.DstIn pass — no blur, no API floor, 60fps. Compose-drawn content (photo/GIF), NOT video
// surfaces. Also on OGImageView as softEdge/maskBrush params. See docs/SOFT_MASKS.md.
fun Modifier.ogSoftClip(shape: Shape, feather: Dp): Modifier    // opaque interior, fades over `feather` at edge
fun Modifier.ogGradientMask(brush: Brush): Modifier             // multiply alpha by a Brush (to Color.Transparent)
```

### Runtime SVG patch — `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.svg`
```kotlin
// Pass overrides = Map<nodeId, OGSvgNodeOverride> to OGSVGView to mutate nodes at runtime (no re-parse).
// Every field is optional; null = leave that aspect unchanged. See docs/RUNTIME_SVG.md.
data class OGSvgNodeOverride(
    val fill: Color? = null, val stroke: Color? = null, val strokeWidth: Float? = null,
    val translateX: Float? = null, val translateY: Float? = null,
    val rotation: Float? = null, val rotationCx: Float? = null, val rotationCy: Float? = null,
    val scaleX: Float? = null, val scaleY: Float? = null,
    val pathData: String? = null,                 // replace a <path>'s geometry
    val pathDataTo: String? = null, val morphProgress: Float = 0f,   // morph the path 0f..1f
)
```

### AI interop (describe → shape / patch) — `com.solidkey.painpoints.ai`
```kotlin
// Provider-agnostic JSON <-> vector primitives. NO network / NO AI SDK in the library: it defines the
// contract, you own the model + the call. Decoding tolerates ```json fences + surrounding prose.
object OGAiVector {
    fun polygonPrompt(instruction: String): String                                   // hand a model the lasso contract
    fun svgPatchPrompt(instruction: String, nodeIds: List<String> = emptyList()): String // + optional allowed ids
    fun decodePolygon(text: String): OGPolygonShape                                   // reply -> clip Shape
    fun decodePolygonOrNull(text: String): OGPolygonShape?
    fun decodeSvgPatch(text: String): Map<String, OGSvgNodeOverride>                  // reply -> OGSVGView overrides
    fun decodeSvgPatchOrNull(text: String): Map<String, OGSvgNodeOverride>?
    fun encodePolygon(shape: OGPolygonShape): String                                  // primitive -> JSON (persist/seed)
    fun encodeSvgPatch(overrides: Map<String, OGSvgNodeOverride>): String
}
// Polygon JSON:  {"points":[{"x":0.5,"y":0.0}, ...]}   (normalized 0..1, top-left origin, >=3, auto-closed)
// SVG patch JSON:{"overrides":{"needle":{"rotation":120,"fill":"#E53935"}, ...}}  (colors: #RGB/#RRGGBB/#AARRGGBB/rgb()/name)
```

## Copy-paste recipes (all compile)

**Photo cropped into a circle:**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.image.OGImageView
import com.solidkey.painpoints.image.loading.OGImageUrlType
import com.solidkey.painpoints.shape.OGShapeType
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale

OGImageView(
    source = OGImageUrlType("https://example.com/face.jpg"),
    modifier = Modifier.size(220.dp),
    displayShape = OGShapeType.CIRCLE,
    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
    onEventTriggered = { _, _ -> },
)
```

**Make a static SVG breathe (scale + rotate loop):**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.image.animating.OGAnimatedImage
import com.solidkey.painpoints.image.animating.OGAnimationType
import com.solidkey.painpoints.image.loading.OGSvgUrlType

OGAnimatedImage(
    source = OGSvgUrlType("https://example.com/logo.svg"),
    animations = setOf(OGAnimationType.SCALE, OGAnimationType.ROTATE),
    durationMillis = 1500,
)
```

**Looping video clipped into a triangle, filling the shape:**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.video.playing.*
import com.solidkey.painpoints.video.loading.OGVideoUrlType
import com.solidkey.painpoints.shape.OGShapeType

OGAVPlayer(
    action = OGAVPlayerAction.PLAY,
    source = OGVideoUrlType("https://example.com/space.mp4"),
    modifier = Modifier.size(300.dp),
    config = OGPlayerConfig(
        displayShape = OGShapeType.TRIANGLE_UP,
        contentScale = OGVideoScale.FILL,
        playbackConfig = OGVideoPlaybackConfig(autoStart = true, autoRepeat = true),
    ),
    onError = { },
)
```

**Fire a caption at 3s and track progress:**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.video.playing.*
import com.solidkey.painpoints.video.loading.OGVideoUrlType

val controller = rememberOGAVPlayerController()
var caption by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

OGAVPlayer(
    action = OGAVPlayerAction.PLAY,
    source = OGVideoUrlType("https://example.com/talk.mp4"),
    controller = controller,
    cues = listOf(
        OGCue.at(3_000) { caption = "Chapter 1" },
        OGCue.range(10_000, 20_000, onEnter = { caption = "Live section" }, onExit = { caption = null }),
    ),
    onProgress = { status -> /* status.progress is 0f..1f */ },
    onError = { },
)
// controller.status.value.positionMs / .durationMs / .progress are live; controller.seekTo(ms)
```

**Depth: fly a sprite over/under a focal plane with depth-of-field:**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.depth.*

OGDepthField(focalDepth = 0.5f, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
    OGDepthObject(depth = 0.2f) { /* far: dimmed + blurred, drawn under */ }
    OGDepthObject(depth = 0.8f) { /* near: sharp, drawn over */ }
}
```

**AI interop: turn a model's reply into a clip shape / SVG patch (you own the model + call):**
```kotlin
import com.solidkey.painpoints.ai.OGAiVector

// describe -> clip region
val star = OGAiVector.decodePolygonOrNull(myLlm.complete(OGAiVector.polygonPrompt("a five-pointed star")))
star?.let { OGImageView(source = OGImageUrlType("https://…/face.jpg"), clipShape = it, onEventTriggered = { _, _ -> }) }

// describe -> SVG patch (constrain to real node ids), applied live via overrides
val prompt = OGAiVector.svgPatchPrompt("point the needle to 80% and turn the arc amber", nodeIds = listOf("needle", "arc"))
OGSVGView(source = OGSvgResourceFileType("gauge.svg"), width = 240f, height = 240f,
          overrides = OGAiVector.decodeSvgPatchOrNull(myLlm.complete(prompt)) ?: emptyMap())
```

## Package map
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.image` — `OGImageView`, color/brush
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.loading` — source types (`OGImageUrlType`, `OGSvgUrlType`, file/resource variants)
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.animating` — `OGAnimatedImage`, `OGAnimatedContainer`, `OGAnimationType`, `OGAnimationSpec`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.svg` / `…svg.animation` — `OGSVGView`, `OGSVGAnimationPlayer`, `SVGScalingBehavior`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.image.transform` — `OGImageTransformConfig`, `OGCropConfig`, `OGResizeConfig`, `OGRotateConfig`, `OGColorConfig`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.video.playing` — `OGAVPlayer`, `OGPlayerConfig`, `OGCue`, `OGPlaybackStatus`, `OGAVPlayerController`, `OGVideoScale`, `OGAVPlayerAction`, `DAVPlayerError`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.video.loading` — `OGVideoUrlType` (+ file/resource variants)
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.audio.playing` — `OGAudioPlayer`, `OGAudioPlaybackConfig`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.depth` — `Modifier.ogDepth`, `OGDepthField`, `OGDepthObject`, `OGDepthConfig`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.shape` — `OGShapeType`, `toShape()`, `OGPolygonShape`, `OGPoint`, `OGMorphShape`, `OGMultiRegionShape` / `OGClipRegion` / `OGClipOp`
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.mask` — `Modifier.ogSoftClip` (feathered edge), `Modifier.ogGradientMask` (gradient alpha)
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.ai` — `OGAiVector` (describe → shape/patch) + `OGPolygonSpec` / `OGSvgPatchSpec` JSON DTOs
- `com.solidkey.painpoints.layer` — `OGLayer`, `OGLayerRenderer`, gestures
